courses.title: 背面供電網路製程
courses.summary: 拆解前後側供電分工、鍵合與薄化、奈米通孔連接，再以壓降、熱與可靠度證據審查整合方案。
courses.summaryEn: Separate signal and power routing, plan bonding, thinning and backside contacts, then review the integration using voltage-drop, thermal and reliability evidence.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的四階段、24 個教學工作包；每步需交出模型、判讀或驗證紀錄。數值練習為自訂教學案例，不是廠商製程配方、現場操作許可或專業設計認證。
courses.scopeEn: Four stages and 24 educational work packages based on public principles. Each step produces a model, interpretation or verification record. Numerical exercises are hypothetical, not manufacturer recipes, field operating authorization or professional design certification.

stages.title: 系統需求與電源路徑
stages.description: 先建立電源與訊號、電阻與暫態的不同證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate power from signals and resistive from transient evidence.

steps.title: 畫出電源與訊號的兩條路徑
steps.titleEn: Draw separate power and signal paths
steps.objective: 區分供電網路與訊號傳播。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish power distribution from signal propagation.
steps.instruction: 先畫封裝、正面金屬及電晶體；用另一色畫背面電源進入點；追蹤 VDD 與 VSS 完整回路；圈出仍留在正面的訊號。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch the package, frontside metals and transistor; add backside power entry in another color; trace the complete VDD and VSS loop; circle signals remaining on the front.
steps.observation: 供電轉到背面後，訊號層並未消失。
steps.observationEn: Moving power does not eliminate signal layers.
steps.failure: 若只畫 VDD，補回回流路徑後再分析壓降。
steps.failureEn: If only VDD is drawn, add the return path before analyzing drop.
steps.check: 交出含兩種網路與回流的截面。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section with both networks and the return path.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 背面供電改變配線分工，不代表把所有訊號移到背面。
knowledge.textEn: Backside power changes routing allocation; it does not move every signal backside.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 電壓是兩點之差，供電與回流都影響元件實際供應。
knowledge.textEn: Voltage is a difference between points; both supply and return affect the device.

quiz.question: 背面供電截面應保留什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What should a backside-power section retain?
options: 正面訊號及完整供電回路。
只有單一 VDD 箭頭。
完全刪除正面互連。
optionsEn: Frontside signals and the complete power loop.
quiz.explanation: 正面訊號及完整供電回路。 背面供電改變配線分工，不代表把所有訊號移到背面。
quiz.explanationEn: Frontside signals and the complete power loop. Backside power changes routing allocation; it does not move every signal backside.

steps.title: 比較三種電源軌配置
steps.objective: 把幾何改善與供電改善分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate geometry gains from delivery gains.
steps.instruction: 畫傳統正面、正面連接埋藏軌、背面連接埋藏軌三圖；逐圖標出接觸點；比較訊號可用空間；列出每種新增介面。
steps.instructionEn: Draw conventional frontside, frontside-connected buried rails and backside-connected buried rails; mark contacts; compare signal space; list added interfaces.
steps.observation: 埋藏軌與背面供電不是完全同義。
steps.observationEn: Buried rails and backside delivery are not synonymous.
steps.failure: 若三圖只換顏色，重新追蹤封裝到元件的連通性。
steps.failureEn: If only colors differ, retrace connectivity from package to device.
steps.check: 表格能分辨軌位置與供電進入側。
steps.checkEn: The table distinguishes rail position from power-entry side.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 電源軌位置和電源進入側是兩個設計選項。
knowledge.textEn: Rail location and power-entry side are separate choices.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 介面增加可能帶來新的對準與可靠度要求。
knowledge.textEn: Additional interfaces can create alignment and reliability requirements.

quiz.question: 有埋藏電源軌就一定由背面供電嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Do buried rails necessarily imply backside delivery?
options: 一定，兩者是同一名詞。
不一定，須追蹤電源連接。
只要有埋藏軌便沒有接觸電阻。
quiz.explanation: 不一定，須追蹤電源連接。 電源軌位置和電源進入側是兩個設計選項。
quiz.explanationEn: No; trace the power connection. Rail location and power-entry side are separate choices.

steps.title: 建立直流壓降帳本
steps.objective: 用簡化電阻網路定位主要損耗。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate losses with a simplified resistive network.
steps.instruction: 自行設定三段串聯電阻與電流並註明是假設；分別計算 I×R；把各段壓降相加；比較加寬其中一段前後結果。
steps.instructionEn: Choose hypothetical current and three series resistances; calculate each I×R drop; sum the drops; compare widening one segment.
steps.observation: 改善最小電阻段不一定改善整體瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: Improving the smallest resistance may barely change the bottleneck.
steps.failure: 勿把示例電阻當成某節點的實測值；補上假設標籤。
steps.failureEn: Do not present example resistances as measurements of a named node.
steps.check: 每段單位、總壓降及最大貢獻可追溯。
steps.checkEn: Units, total drop and largest contributor are traceable.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 串聯路徑的電阻貢獻需逐段相加。
knowledge.textEn: Series-path resistance contributions add.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: R 的變化與 I 的變化都會改變壓降，不能只比較線寬。
knowledge.textEn: Both resistance and current change drop; width alone is insufficient.

quiz.question: 哪一段先值得改善？
quiz.questionEn: Which segment warrants attention first?
options: 顏色最深的段。
永遠是最靠近封裝的一段。
在同一電流條件下壓降最大的段。
optionsEn: Always the segment nearest the package.
The largest-drop segment at the same current.
quiz.explanation: 在同一電流條件下壓降最大的段。 串聯路徑的電阻貢獻需逐段相加。
quiz.explanationEn: The largest-drop segment at the same current. Series-path resistance contributions add.

steps.title: 分開靜態壓降與瞬態下陷
steps.titleEn: Separate static drop from transient droop
steps.objective: 辨識負載突變造成的時間效應。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify time-dependent effects of load changes.
steps.instruction: 畫穩定負載與階躍負載兩條曲線；標出電流變化時刻；把穩態壓降與短暫谷值分別量測；比較兩種去耦配置的假設波形。
steps.instructionEn: Draw steady and stepped loads; mark the current transition; measure steady drop separately from the temporary minimum; compare two hypothetical decoupling waveforms.
steps.observation: 相同直流電阻仍可能有不同瞬態谷值。
steps.observationEn: Equal DC resistance can coexist with different transient minima.
steps.failure: 只用平均電壓會漏掉谷值；保留時間尺度。
steps.failureEn: Average voltage can conceal minima; retain the time scale.
steps.check: 報告同時列出穩態值、最小值及恢復時間。
steps.checkEn: Report steady value, minimum and recovery time.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 電源網路有寄生電感與電容，暫態不能只用電阻描述。
knowledge.textEn: Parasitic inductance and capacitance make transient behavior more than resistance.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 不同量測頻寬會改變可見的快速事件。
knowledge.textEn: Measurement bandwidth changes which fast events are visible.

quiz.question: 平均電壓相同能證明瞬態相同嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does equal average voltage prove equal transients?
options: 不能，需比較谷值與時間響應。
能，平均值涵蓋全部頻率。
能，只要晶片尺寸相同。
quiz.explanation: 不能，需比較谷值與時間響應。 電源網路有寄生電感與電容，暫態不能只用電阻描述。
quiz.explanationEn: No; compare minima and timing. Parasitic inductance and capacitance make transient behavior more than resistance.

steps.title: 檢查標準元件配線容量
steps.objective: 評估釋放電源軌空間的實際收益。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate usable space released by power routing.
steps.instruction: 畫四個相鄰標準元件；分開標記電源軌與訊號軌；移動電源後重新連接訊號；記錄仍因通孔或禁佈區受限的位置。
steps.instructionEn: Draw four adjacent cells; mark power and signal tracks separately; reroute signals after relocating power; record remaining via and keep-out constraints.
steps.observation: 可用面積增加不等於所有線都能順利佈完。
steps.observationEn: More area does not guarantee routability.
steps.failure: 若只按面積比例推算頻率，增加實際線長與擁塞比較。
steps.failureEn: If frequency is inferred from area alone, add route-length and congestion checks.
steps.check: 交付前後配置及一處仍未解決的擁塞。
steps.checkEn: Submit before/after layouts and one remaining congestion point.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 設計與技術協同最佳化需同時考慮元件與配線限制。
knowledge.textEn: Design-technology co-optimization considers cells and routing together.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 面積、速度、功耗的比較必須使用一致工作負載與限制。
knowledge.textEn: Area, speed and power comparisons need matching workloads and constraints.

quiz.question: 釋放面積後應再驗證什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What should be checked after space is released?
options: 只看空白面積就宣告性能提升。
訊號能否佈通以及路徑延遲。
刪除所有禁佈區以完成比較。
optionsEn: Declare performance from blank area alone.
Remove all keep-outs to finish comparison.
quiz.explanation: 訊號能否佈通以及路徑延遲。 設計與技術協同最佳化需同時考慮元件與配線限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Signal routability and path delay. Design-technology co-optimization considers cells and routing together.

steps.title: 選擇測試載具與對照組
steps.objective: 把新供電技術與電晶體改版的影響分離。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate delivery changes from transistor changes.
steps.instruction: 列出電晶體、電源網路及工作負載三項變因；設計只改供電的對照；指定前後量測；記錄尚不能歸因的差異。
steps.instructionEn: List transistor, delivery network and workload variables; design a delivery-only comparison; specify before/after measurements; record unattributable differences.
steps.observation: 同時更改多項技術會混淆原因。
steps.observationEn: Changing several technologies confounds attribution.
steps.failure: 若對照的尺寸與溫度不同，先統一條件再比較。
steps.failureEn: Match geometry and temperature before comparing controls.
steps.check: 一張實驗矩陣說明固定、改變及量測項。
steps.checkEn: Provide a matrix of fixed, changed and measured items.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 測試載具可先驗證單一整合風險。
knowledge.textEn: A test vehicle can isolate an integration risk.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 研究晶片的改善不自動等於產品在所有負載下的改善。
knowledge.textEn: Test-chip gains are not automatic product gains under every workload.

quiz.question: 只想判斷背面供電效益，應如何設計？
quiz.questionEn: How should a delivery-specific benefit be tested?
options: 同時更换架構與工作負載。
只挑表現最好的一筆數據。
保持其他主要變因一致。
quiz.explanation: 保持其他主要變因一致。 測試載具可先驗證單一整合風險。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep other major variables comparable. A test vehicle can isolate an integration risk.

stages.title: 鍵合、薄化與前後對準
stages.description: 用截面與誤差帳本理解背面加工的依存關係。
stages.descriptionEn: Use sections and error budgets to understand backside integration dependencies.

steps.title: 建立前後面方向與標記
steps.objective: 避免翻面後座標與極性誤判。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid coordinate and polarity errors after flipping.
steps.instruction: 畫俯視與截面基準；標出缺口與三個不對稱標記；紙上翻面後重標座標；追蹤同一 VDD 接點的位置。
steps.instructionEn: Draw plan and section references; add a notch and three asymmetric marks; relabel coordinates after a paper flip; track the same VDD contact.
steps.observation: 翻轉與平面旋轉對圖案的影響不同。
steps.observationEn: A flip and an in-plane rotation transform patterns differently.
steps.failure: 對稱標記無法辨認鏡像時，增加不對稱識別。
steps.failureEn: Add an asymmetric identifier if marks cannot distinguish mirroring.
steps.check: 兩視圖間同一接點能唯一對應。
steps.checkEn: Each contact has one unambiguous cross-view match.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 背面加工需要將量測座標連回正面元件。
knowledge.textEn: Backside processing must relate measurements to frontside devices.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 標記本身也需在薄化及堆疊後可辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Marks must remain identifiable after thinning and stacking.

quiz.question: 哪種標記較能揭露翻面錯誤？
quiz.questionEn: Which mark best exposes a flip error?
options: 可區分鏡像的不對稱標記。
完全均勻的圓。
沒有方向定義的網格。
optionsEn: An asymmetric mark that distinguishes mirrors.
quiz.explanation: 可區分鏡像的不對稱標記。 背面加工需要將量測座標連回正面元件。
quiz.explanationEn: An asymmetric mark that distinguishes mirrors. Backside processing must relate measurements to frontside devices.

steps.title: 規劃載板鍵合的支撐
steps.objective: 理解薄晶圓加工的機械邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand mechanical boundaries during thin-wafer processing.
steps.instruction: 畫主動晶圓與載板的接合面；標出後續加工施力位置；比較完全支撐與局部空隙；建立加工前空隙檢查清單。
steps.instructionEn: Draw active wafer and carrier interfaces; mark later loading locations; compare full support with a local void; create a pre-processing void check.
steps.observation: 局部失去支撐可能造成厚度或應力異常。
steps.observationEn: A local support gap can produce thickness or stress anomalies.
steps.failure: 不能以外側貼合外觀證明內部無空隙；指定適合的非破壞檢查。
steps.failureEn: Outer appearance does not establish void-free bonding; specify suitable nondestructive inspection.
steps.check: 示意圖標明支撐、空隙與驗證位置。
steps.checkEn: Label support, voids and inspection positions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 載板提供薄化期間的機械支撐。
knowledge.textEn: A carrier provides support during thinning.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 鍵合平整度也會影響後續對準與量測。
knowledge.textEn: Bond geometry also affects later alignment and measurement.

quiz.question: 局部空隙最先影響哪種假設？
quiz.questionEn: Which assumption is challenged by a local void?
options: 電晶體數量固定。
晶圓各處具有一致支撐。
所有訊號都在背面。
quiz.explanation: 晶圓各處具有一致支撐。 載板提供薄化期間的機械支撐。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform support across the wafer. A carrier provides support during thinning.

steps.title: 分配薄化餘量
steps.objective: 用最薄區而非平均值控制去除預算。
steps.objectiveEn: Budget removal using local minima, not only averages.
steps.instruction: 建立九點假設厚度圖；列出粗去除、精修與終點餘量；逐點相減；標記最先失去餘量的區域。
steps.instructionEn: Create a hypothetical nine-point thickness map; allocate coarse removal, finishing and endpoint margin; subtract pointwise; mark the first region to lose margin.
steps.observation: 平均厚度合格時仍可能有局部過薄。
steps.observationEn: Local over-thinning can occur despite an acceptable average.
steps.failure: 若用單一平均值，回到位置配對的前後圖。
steps.failureEn: Replace an average-only analysis with paired spatial maps.
steps.check: 每區剩餘量非負，且列出需重檢的極值。
steps.checkEn: Each region retains nonnegative margin and flagged extrema are listed.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 材料去除不可由後續拋光補回。
knowledge.textEn: Subsequent polishing cannot restore removed material.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 終點需符合元件與接觸設計，不是越薄越好。
knowledge.textEn: The endpoint must suit device and contact design; thinner is not always better.

quiz.question: 薄化應優先留意哪項？
quiz.questionEn: What deserves priority during thinning review?
options: 照片最亮的區域。
僅全片平均加工時間。
局部最小剩餘厚度。
quiz.explanation: 局部最小剩餘厚度。 材料去除不可由後續拋光補回。
quiz.explanationEn: Minimum local remaining thickness. Subsequent polishing cannot restore removed material.

steps.title: 辨認薄化終點證據
steps.objective: 區分厚度讀值與露出目標層。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish thickness readings from target-layer exposure.
steps.instruction: 畫三種截面：未到、剛到與過度去除；為各截面選擇厚度或材料辨識證據；比較中心與邊緣結果；標示不能由光澤判定的部分。
steps.instructionEn: Draw under-thinned, target and over-thinned sections; choose thickness or material-identification evidence; compare center and edge; mark what gloss cannot establish.
steps.observation: 幾何厚度與材料種類回答不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Geometry and material identity answer different questions.
steps.failure: 未證實目標層前，不把時間到了當成終點。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat elapsed time as proof of target-layer exposure.
steps.check: 三種截面各有可區分的量測判據。
steps.checkEn: Each section has a discriminating measurement criterion.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 薄化流程需要可重複的終點指標。
knowledge.textEn: A thinning flow needs a reproducible endpoint indicator.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 量測需保留校正與空間範圍，才能比較不同區域。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration and spatial extent are needed to compare regions.

quiz.question: 只看加工時間可否證明已露出目標層？
quiz.questionEn: Does processing time prove the target layer is exposed?
options: 不能，需材料或厚度證據。
可以，相同時間一定相同厚度。
可以，背面顏色一定唯一。
optionsEn: No; material or thickness evidence is needed.
Yes; equal time guarantees equal thickness.
Yes; backside color is always unique.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需材料或厚度證據。 薄化流程需要可重複的終點指標。
quiz.explanationEn: No; material or thickness evidence is needed. A thinning flow needs a reproducible endpoint indicator.

steps.title: 分解前後側對準誤差
steps.objective: 辨認全片位移與局部形變。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish global offsets from local distortion.
steps.instruction: 在九個位置畫設計與實測標記；先扣除共同平移；再比較旋轉與殘差；把局部不規則量保留為未解釋項。
steps.instructionEn: Draw designed and measured marks at nine sites; remove common translation; compare rotation and residuals; retain irregular local errors as unexplained.
steps.observation: 消除平均偏差後仍可能有局部錯位。
steps.observationEn: Local misalignment can remain after average offset removal.
steps.failure: 只報平均誤差可能抵消正負值；增加最大值與位置圖。
steps.failureEn: Signed errors can cancel in averages; add maxima and maps.
steps.check: 提交原始、校正後及殘差三張圖。
steps.checkEn: Submit raw, corrected and residual maps.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 鍵合形變可能影響後續微影對準。
knowledge.textEn: Bond-induced distortion can affect later lithographic alignment.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 誤差預算應保留量測不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: An error budget should retain measurement uncertainty.

quiz.question: 平均位移為零代表全部對準嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does zero mean offset prove alignment everywhere?
options: 代表，正負誤差已物理消失。
不代表，局部殘差可能存在。
代表，旋轉不影响接點。
optionsEn: Yes; opposite errors have physically vanished.
quiz.explanation: 不代表，局部殘差可能存在。 鍵合形變可能影響後續微影對準。
quiz.explanationEn: No; local residuals may remain. Bond-induced distortion can affect later lithographic alignment.

steps.title: 審查前段元件相容性
steps.objective: 將新增加工視為可驗證的應力來源。
steps.objectiveEn: Treat additional processing as a testable stress source.
steps.instruction: 列出鍵合、薄化、背面加工三個節點；為每節點指定前後電性量測；固定量測溫度；對照一組未做新增流程的測試元件。
steps.instructionEn: List bonding, thinning and backside-processing checkpoints; assign before/after electrical tests; fix test temperature; compare controls without the added flow.
steps.observation: 結果變化應與流程節點和量測條件關聯。
steps.observationEn: Changes should be related to process checkpoints and measurement conditions.
steps.failure: 不同量測溫度可能製造假退化；先核對測試條件。
steps.failureEn: Different test temperatures can mimic degradation; verify conditions first.
steps.check: 差異表能區分元件變化與量測漂移。
steps.checkEn: The comparison distinguishes device changes from measurement drift.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 未退化的研究展示只適用其測試條件。
knowledge.textEn: A non-degradation result applies to its tested conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 前後配對比獨立批次平均更能定位變化。
knowledge.textEn: Paired before/after data can localize changes better than separate batch averages.

quiz.question: 某研究元件未退化，可否保證所有產品？
quiz.questionEn: Does one non-degraded research device guarantee every product?
options: 可以，薄化永遠無影響。
可以，電性只由正面尺寸決定。
不能，需依各整合條件再驗證。
optionsEn: Yes; frontside dimensions alone determine behavior.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需依各整合條件再驗證。 未退化的研究展示只適用其測試條件。
quiz.explanationEn: No; each integration needs verification. A non-degradation result applies to its tested conditions.

stages.title: 背面接觸與配線整合
stages.description: 檢查連接、絕緣、熱路徑及製程相容性。
stages.descriptionEn: Review connectivity, insulation, thermal paths and process compatibility.

steps.title: 比較埋藏軌與直接接觸
steps.objective: 辨識不同背面連接策略的介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify interfaces in alternative backside connections.
steps.instruction: 畫背面通孔接埋藏軌的路徑；另畫直接接近源汲極的概念路徑；比較落點面積；列出隔離與對準問題，避免混用兩種流程。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a backside via landing on a buried rail; sketch a conceptual direct device connection; compare landing areas; list isolation and alignment concerns without mixing flows.
steps.observation: 不同方案可共享目標但不共享所有步驟。
steps.observationEn: Schemes can share goals without sharing every process step.
steps.failure: 若移植一個方案的規則，先確認結構是否相同。
steps.failureEn: Check structural equivalence before transferring a rule.
steps.check: 以介面表說明兩者共同點與差異。
steps.checkEn: Provide an interface table of similarities and differences.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 背面連接不是單一固定架構。
knowledge.textEn: Backside connectivity is not one fixed architecture.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 較短路徑仍需付出可製造性與隔離驗證。
knowledge.textEn: A shorter path still requires manufacturability and isolation verification.

quiz.question: 兩種方案可直接共用完整流程嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can both schemes use an identical complete flow?
options: 不能，落點與隔離結構不同。
可以，只需更改名稱。
可以，通孔不需要對準。
optionsEn: No; landing and isolation structures differ.
quiz.explanation: 不能，落點與隔離結構不同。 背面連接不是單一固定架構。
quiz.explanationEn: No; landing and isolation structures differ. Backside connectivity is not one fixed architecture.

steps.title: 檢查通孔的絕緣與導通
steps.objective: 分開開路、短路與高阻三種缺陷。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate open, shorted and high-resistance faults.
steps.instruction: 畫正常、填充空隙、側壁隔離破損三個截面；逐一預測導通與漏電結果；把電性結果配回截面；提出可排除另一原因的追加檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Draw sound, voided and insulation-damaged vias; predict continuity and leakage; match results to sections; propose a check excluding an alternative cause.
steps.observation: 導通良好不代表與鄰近結構隔離良好。
steps.observationEn: Good continuity does not prove isolation from neighbors.
steps.failure: 若只測通斷，增加隔離證據，不據此猜測材料配方。
steps.failureEn: Add isolation evidence to continuity testing; do not infer a recipe.
steps.check: 缺陷矩陣包含導通、電阻及隔離三欄。
steps.checkEn: The fault matrix includes continuity, resistance and isolation.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 導電路徑與隔離邊界需同時成立。
knowledge.textEn: The conductive path and insulating boundary must both work.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 不同缺陷可能有相同單一測試結果。
knowledge.textEn: Different defects can share a single test signature.

quiz.question: 只測到導通足以放行嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is continuity alone enough for release?
options: 足夠，短路也算完成連接。
不足，還須檢查電阻及隔離。
足夠，漏電只發生於正面。
optionsEn: Yes; a short also counts as connection.
No; resistance and isolation also matter.
Yes; leakage occurs only on the front.
quiz.explanation: 不足，還須檢查電阻及隔離。 導電路徑與隔離邊界需同時成立。
quiz.explanationEn: No; resistance and isolation also matter. The conductive path and insulating boundary must both work.

steps.title: 建立接觸電阻的比較
steps.objective: 避免把線路電阻誤當成接觸電阻。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid confusing line resistance with contact resistance.
steps.instruction: 畫兩端量測含引線的模型；再畫四端感測的概念配置；給引線相同假設增量；比較兩種讀值受影響程度。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a two-terminal model including leads; sketch conceptual four-terminal sensing; add the same hypothetical lead resistance; compare measurement sensitivity.
steps.observation: 測到的總阻值可能含測試結構本身。
steps.observationEn: Measured resistance can include the test structure.
steps.failure: 若沒有結構資訊，將結果標為總路徑阻值。
steps.failureEn: Without structure information, label the value total-path resistance.
steps.check: 報告說明感測點與未扣除的寄生項。
steps.checkEn: State sensing locations and unremoved parasitics.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 接觸、通孔與金屬線共同形成路徑電阻。
knowledge.textEn: Contacts, vias and lines contribute to path resistance.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 量測方法影響可分離出的物理量。
knowledge.textEn: The measurement method determines which quantities can be isolated.

quiz.question: 兩端讀值增加一定代表接觸退化嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does higher two-terminal resistance prove contact degradation?
options: 一定，線路不可能有電阻。
一定，探針接觸永遠理想。
不一定，引線與通孔也可能改變。
optionsEn: Yes; probe contact is always ideal.
No; leads or vias may also have changed.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，引線與通孔也可能改變。 接觸、通孔與金屬線共同形成路徑電阻。
quiz.explanationEn: No; leads or vias may also have changed. Contacts, vias and lines contribute to path resistance.

steps.title: 規劃背面金屬網路
steps.objective: 平衡供電覆蓋、壓降與區域需求。
steps.objectiveEn: Balance power coverage, drop and regional demand.
steps.instruction: 把假設晶片分成四個負載區；分配電源入口與網格；用相同總金屬量比較均勻與偏重熱點的方案；檢查最遠路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Divide a hypothetical die into four load zones; place entries and a grid; compare uniform and hotspot-weighted metal at equal total amount; inspect the longest path.
steps.observation: 相同金屬總量可以有不同最差壓降。
steps.observationEn: Equal metal quantity can produce different worst-case drops.
steps.failure: 若只最佳化平均值，重新檢查最高負載與邊角區。
steps.failureEn: After average-only optimization, revisit peak-load and corner regions.
steps.check: 交出兩方案的負載圖、路徑與取捨。
steps.checkEn: Submit load maps, paths and tradeoffs for both schemes.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 供電網路需配合負載空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Power routing should match spatial load demand.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 電源入口位置與網格密度共同影響路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Entry locations and grid density jointly shape paths.

quiz.question: 相同總金屬量是否代表相同供電品質？
quiz.questionEn: Does equal metal quantity imply equal delivery quality?
options: 否，配置與負載分布仍不同。
是，只要面積相同。
是，電流均勻分配與負載無關。
optionsEn: No; topology and load distribution differ.
Yes; current divides independently of load.
quiz.explanation: 否，配置與負載分布仍不同。 供電網路需配合負載空間分布。
quiz.explanationEn: No; topology and load distribution differ. Power routing should match spatial load demand.

steps.title: 追蹤去耦電容的作用
steps.titleEn: Trace the role of decoupling capacitance
steps.objective: 把暫態支援與直流供電分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate transient support from steady power supply.
steps.instruction: 畫負載、寄生路徑與去耦支路；假設同一電流脈衝；比較電容靠近與遠離負載的回路；標出寄生電感可能削弱效果的位置。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the load, parasitic path and decoupling branch; apply the same hypothetical current pulse; compare near and distant loops; mark where inductance weakens the response.
steps.observation: 加大電容不能自動消除所有頻率的阻抗。
steps.observationEn: Increasing capacitance does not eliminate impedance at every frequency.
steps.failure: 若只列電容量，補回連接路徑及頻率條件。
steps.failureEn: Add connection-path and frequency conditions to capacitance alone.
steps.check: 以回路圖解释一種配置較有效的原因。
steps.checkEn: Explain a configuration advantage using a loop diagram.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 去耦提供短時間能量緩衝。
knowledge.textEn: Decoupling provides a short-term energy buffer.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 電容位置、連接寄生與負載頻譜同樣重要。
knowledge.textEn: Location, connection parasitics and load spectrum also matter.

quiz.question: 比較去耦方案時還需什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What else matters when comparing decoupling?
options: 只有標稱電容量。
連接回路與頻率範圍。
只看電容顏色。
quiz.explanation: 連接回路與頻率範圍。 去耦提供短時間能量緩衝。
quiz.explanationEn: Connection loop and frequency range. Decoupling provides a short-term energy buffer.

steps.title: 審查散熱與薄基板
steps.titleEn: Review heat flow through a thin substrate
steps.objective: 辨認薄化如何改變熱擴散路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify how thinning changes heat spreading.
steps.instruction: 畫元件、薄矽、背面金屬與封裝的熱路徑；分別標熱源及散熱邊界；比較兩種金屬分布；列出需模擬的局部溫升。
steps.instructionEn: Draw thermal paths through devices, thin silicon, backside metal and package; mark sources and sinks; compare two metal layouts; list local temperature rises needing simulation.
steps.observation: 較低電阻不保證每個熱點都更冷。
steps.observationEn: Lower resistance does not guarantee every hotspot is cooler.
steps.failure: 若宣稱薄化一定改善散熱，重新比較垂直與橫向路徑。
steps.failureEn: Revisit vertical and lateral paths before claiming thinning always improves cooling.
steps.check: 熱路徑圖清楚區分電性收益與熱風險。
steps.checkEn: The diagram separates electrical benefits from thermal risks.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 薄化會改變原本矽基板的熱擴散能力。
knowledge.textEn: Thinning changes heat spreading through silicon.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 背面金屬可能提供新熱路徑，但需依幾何驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Backside metal can provide new thermal paths, subject to geometry.

quiz.question: 背面供電電阻降低就一定不過熱嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does lower delivery resistance rule out overheating?
options: 一定，電阻是唯一熱參數。
一定，薄矽沒有熱容量。
不一定，仍需熱模型與邊界條件。
optionsEn: Yes; resistance is the only thermal parameter.
Yes; thin silicon has no heat capacity.
No; a thermal model and boundaries are needed.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，仍需熱模型與邊界條件。 薄化會改變原本矽基板的熱擴散能力。
quiz.explanationEn: No; a thermal model and boundaries are needed. Thinning changes heat spreading through silicon.

stages.title: 電性、可靠度與設計審查
stages.description: 以對照組、失效定位與交付證據判讀方案。
stages.descriptionEn: Evaluate the design through controls, failure localization and release evidence.

steps.title: 建立晶圓內電性地圖
steps.objective: 區分共同偏移與局部缺陷。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate shared shifts from local faults.
steps.instruction: 在九點地圖填假設通孔電阻；標記加工前後差值；比較邊緣與中心；檢查異常是否與厚度或對準殘差共位。
steps.instructionEn: Place hypothetical via resistances on a nine-site map; calculate before/after changes; compare edge and center; check co-location with thickness or overlay residuals.
steps.observation: 相關位置可提出假說，不能單獨證明原因。
steps.observationEn: Spatial correlation suggests a hypothesis but does not prove causation.
steps.failure: 若只挑單點最佳結果，恢復全圖及失敗點。
steps.failureEn: Restore the full map and failures if only the best point was selected.
steps.check: 每個異常有位置、對照項及追加檢查。
steps.checkEn: Each anomaly has a location, comparator and follow-up check.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 位置配對能串接多種量測證據。
knowledge.textEn: Spatial pairing connects different measurement evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 全片均值會掩蓋局部短路或高阻。
knowledge.textEn: A whole-wafer average can hide local shorts or high resistance.

quiz.question: 異常電阻和薄區重疊代表什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does resistance/thickness co-location establish?
options: 值得追查的關聯，尚非因果證明。
已證明唯一失效原因。
所有其他量測都不必要。
optionsEn: A useful association, not yet causation.
The sole failure cause is proven.
quiz.explanation: 值得追查的關聯，尚非因果證明。 位置配對能串接多種量測證據。
quiz.explanationEn: A useful association, not yet causation. Spatial pairing connects different measurement evidence.

steps.title: 比較電流密度與可靠度
steps.objective: 將截面瓶頸與壽命評估連起來。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect cross-sectional bottlenecks to reliability review.
steps.instruction: 畫兩種不同截面接點；用假設 I/A 比較平均電流密度；圈出轉角及縮頸；列出溫度與時間需一併記錄的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Draw contacts with two cross-sections; compare hypothetical I/A averages; circle corners and necks; explain why temperature and duration must also be recorded.
steps.observation: 平均密度未反映所有局部擁擠。
steps.observationEn: Average density does not capture all local crowding.
steps.failure: 勿把簡化比值直接換成壽命；保留材料與幾何未知項。
steps.failureEn: Do not convert a simple ratio into lifetime; retain material and geometry uncertainties.
steps.check: 結果只排序風險，不虛構產品壽命。
steps.checkEn: Results rank concerns without inventing product lifetime.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 較小有效截面在相同電流下有較高平均電流密度。
knowledge.textEn: A smaller effective area has higher average density at equal current.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 可靠度需要時間、溫度與局部結構的聯合證據。
knowledge.textEn: Reliability needs evidence about duration, temperature and local structure.

quiz.question: I/A 可以直接算出產品壽命嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can I/A alone determine product lifetime?
options: 可以，與溫度無關。
不能，它只是風險分析的一部分。
可以，所有材料完全相同。
optionsEn: No; it is one part of the analysis.
quiz.explanation: 不能，它只是風險分析的一部分。 較小有效截面在相同電流下有較高平均電流密度。
quiz.explanationEn: No; it is one part of the analysis. A smaller effective area has higher average density at equal current.

steps.title: 規劃 ESD 保護路徑
steps.objective: 理解保護導通與熱承受是不同條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish protection conduction from thermal survival.
steps.instruction: 畫正常供電與瞬態放電路徑；標出保護元件及回流；比較薄化前後的散熱體積；建立僅供模型審查的失效假說。
steps.instructionEn: Draw normal power and transient discharge paths; mark protection devices and return; compare heat-spreading volume before/after thinning; form model-review failure hypotheses.
steps.observation: 保護元件能導通仍可能局部過熱。
steps.observationEn: A conducting protection device can still overheat locally.
steps.failure: 不在真實晶片施加放電；用公開原理及假設模型討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not discharge real chips; discuss public principles and hypothetical models.
steps.check: 圖中同時標示電流與熱兩條路徑。
steps.checkEn: The diagram includes electrical and thermal paths.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: ESD 防護需同時處理電流分流與能量散逸。
knowledge.textEn: ESD protection addresses both current diversion and energy dissipation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 薄基板的保護策略需重新檢查熱限制。
knowledge.textEn: Thin-substrate protection requires renewed thermal review.

quiz.question: 導通測試通過便代表 ESD 保護完整嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does passing continuity establish complete ESD protection?
options: 代表，放電完全沒有熱。
代表，薄化不改變材料體積。
不代表，熱承受與路徑仍需驗證。
optionsEn: No; thermal survival and pathways still need checks.
quiz.explanation: 不代表，熱承受與路徑仍需驗證。 ESD 防護需同時處理電流分流與能量散逸。
quiz.explanationEn: No; thermal survival and pathways still need checks. ESD protection addresses both current diversion and energy dissipation.

steps.title: 建立失效定位決策樹
steps.objective: 以最少追加證據分辨可能原因。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish causes with targeted additional evidence.
steps.instruction: 從高壓降案例出發列出高負載、高阻與量測偏移；為每支假說選一個可否證觀察；依非破壞性排檢查順序；記錄哪些結論仍不確定。
steps.instructionEn: Start with excessive drop and list high load, high resistance and measurement offset; choose a falsifying observation per branch; order nondestructive checks; record unresolved conclusions.
steps.observation: 同一症狀可以來自不同子系統。
steps.observationEn: One symptom can originate in different subsystems.
steps.failure: 若直接把異常歸為薄化失敗，補上排除負載及測試偏差的證據。
steps.failureEn: Exclude load and measurement changes before blaming thinning.
steps.check: 每支分支有輸入、判据與後續動作。
steps.checkEn: Each branch has input, criterion and follow-up action.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 診斷流程應區分症狀與物理原因。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnosis distinguishes symptoms from physical causes.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 有效檢查需能改變判斷，而非重複同一讀值。
knowledge.textEn: A useful check changes the inference instead of repeating the same value.

quiz.question: 高壓降首先證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: What does excessive drop establish first?
options: 供電表現異常，原因仍需區分。
一定是通孔空隙。
一定是背面微影失效。
optionsEn: Delivery is abnormal; the cause remains to be distinguished.
It must be a via void.
It must be backside lithography failure.
quiz.explanation: 供電表現異常，原因仍需區分。 診斷流程應區分症狀與物理原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Delivery is abnormal; the cause remains to be distinguished. Diagnosis distinguishes symptoms from physical causes.

steps.title: 連結混合鍵合與封裝課程
steps.objective: 比較共享的介面問題與不同功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare shared interface problems and different functions.
steps.instruction: 把背面供電、晶圓混合鍵合及先進封裝排在一張介面圖；圈出對準、平坦度與連接電阻共同項；標示訊號與電源目標差異；選一個衍生課程繼續。
steps.instructionEn: Place backside power, wafer hybrid bonding and advanced packaging on one interface map; circle alignment, flatness and resistance concerns; distinguish signal and power goals; choose a related course.
steps.observation: 共用量測觀念不表示可互換流程。
steps.observationEn: Shared metrology concepts do not make flows interchangeable.
steps.failure: 若直接套用鍵合間距，先核對接點用途與結構。
steps.failureEn: Verify contact purpose and structure before transferring a bonding pitch.
steps.check: 比較表至少列出兩共同點與一差異。
steps.checkEn: List at least two similarities and one difference.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 多層整合共同依賴清楚的介面定義。
knowledge.textEn: Multilevel integration relies on clear interface definitions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 同一量測名稱在不同尺度下仍需重新定義取樣範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The same measurement name still needs a scale-specific sampling definition.

quiz.question: 相似工法最適合轉移什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What transfers best between related processes?
options: 整套未知設備設定。
問題分析與驗證方法，再確認適用條件。
所有幾何尺寸直接照搬。
optionsEn: Analysis and verification methods, with applicability checked.
quiz.explanation: 問題分析與驗證方法，再確認適用條件。 多層整合共同依賴清楚的介面定義。
quiz.explanationEn: Analysis and verification methods, with applicability checked. Multilevel integration relies on clear interface definitions.

steps.title: 完成總工程師整合審查
steps.objective: 建立可追溯且不誇大結論的交付包。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a traceable review package without overstating results.
steps.instruction: 整理截面、壓降帳本與對準地圖；列出三項已驗證及三項未知；提出下一輪對照實驗；用一頁說明放行或暫緩的理由。
steps.instructionEn: Collect sections, drop ledger and overlay maps; list three verified and three unknown items; propose the next controlled comparison; justify release or hold on one page.
steps.observation: 證據完整度與性能數字大小是兩回事。
steps.observationEn: Evidence completeness differs from the size of a performance gain.
steps.failure: 沒有實測或有效模型的項目維持待驗證，不填入廠商保證。
steps.failureEn: Keep unsupported items unverified rather than adding manufacturer guarantees.
steps.check: 每项結論可連回來源、假設或自己的計算。
steps.checkEn: Every conclusion traces to a source, assumption or calculation.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 設計審查評估證據與限制，不只展示最漂亮的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Design review evaluates evidence and limits, not only favorable results.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 教育模型可訓練判讀，但不取代製程資格認證。
knowledge.textEn: Educational models train interpretation but do not replace process qualification.

quiz.question: 哪種交付最能支持下一步決策？
quiz.questionEn: Which deliverable best supports the next decision?
options: 只列最高改善百分比。
把所有待驗證項改成通過。
包含假設、失敗與未知項的證據包。
optionsEn: Evidence including assumptions, failures and unknowns.
quiz.explanation: 包含假設、失敗與未知項的證據包。 設計審查評估證據與限制，不只展示最漂亮的結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Evidence including assumptions, failures and unknowns. Design review evaluates evidence and limits, not only favorable results.

courses.title: 高數值孔徑 EUV 成像
courses.summary: 從解析度、非等倍率光學、光罩與薄光阻，到接縫、焦距控制及缺陷量測，完成 High-NA EUV 成像整合審查。
courses.summaryEn: Review High-NA EUV imaging from resolution and anamorphic optics through masks, thin resist, field stitching, focus control and defect metrology.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的四階段、24 個教學工作包；每步需交出模型、判讀或驗證紀錄。數值練習為自訂教學案例，不是廠商製程配方、現場操作許可或專業設計認證。
courses.scopeEn: Four stages and 24 educational work packages based on public principles. Each step produces a model, interpretation or verification record. Numerical exercises are hypothetical, not manufacturer recipes, field operating authorization or professional design certification.

stages.title: 成像與光學預算
stages.description: 比較解析度、焦深、反射光路與非等倍率。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare resolution, depth of focus, reflective paths and anamorphic scaling.

steps.title: 分開節點名稱與實際線寬
steps.titleEn: Separate node labels from feature dimensions
steps.objective: 建立不混淆的尺度表。
steps.objectiveEn: Build an unambiguous scale table.
steps.instruction: 列出節點名稱、線寬、節距與波長四欄；畫兩條線標出線寬與節距；把公開光學解析度放在正確欄位；標記未公開的元件尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: List node label, linewidth, pitch and wavelength; draw two lines with width and pitch; place published optical resolution in its proper column; mark unpublished device dimensions.
steps.observation: 節點名稱不能直接代入每個幾何尺寸。
steps.observationEn: A node label is not every physical dimension.
steps.failure: 若把「2 nm」當成所有線寬，退回欄位定義。
steps.failureEn: Revisit definitions if a 2 nm label is treated as every linewidth.
steps.check: 示意圖清楚區分至少三種尺度。
steps.checkEn: The diagram clearly distinguishes at least three scales.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 微影解析度與半導體節點命名描述不同層面。
knowledge.textEn: Lithographic resolution and node naming describe different aspects.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 節距包含線與間距，不能只報線寬。
knowledge.textEn: Pitch includes a line and space; linewidth alone is insufficient.

quiz.question: 節點名稱能直接代表所有線寬嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a node name directly specify all linewidths?
options: 不能，需使用各層實際尺寸定義。
可以，每一條線都等於節點數字。
可以，節距與波長也相同。
optionsEn: Yes; every line equals the node number.
Yes; pitch and wavelength are identical too.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需使用各層實際尺寸定義。 微影解析度與半導體節點命名描述不同層面。
quiz.explanationEn: No; use layer-specific dimensions. Lithographic resolution and node naming describe different aspects.

steps.title: 用 Rayleigh 關係比較 NA
steps.titleEn: Compare numerical aperture with Rayleigh scaling
steps.objective: 在固定條件下判斷解析度趨勢。
steps.objectiveEn: Assess resolution trends under fixed conditions.
steps.instruction: 寫出 R=k1×λ/NA；固定 k1 與波長；比較 NA 0.33 與 0.55 的比值；列出不能保持固定時需重新建模的項目。
steps.instructionEn: Write R=k1×wavelength/NA; hold k1 and wavelength fixed; compare NA 0.33 and 0.55; list what must be remodeled if assumptions change.
steps.observation: NA 增大使理想化可解析尺寸減小。
steps.observationEn: Higher NA reduces the idealized resolvable size.
steps.failure: 不把此比例直接當成晶片效能倍數。
steps.failureEn: Do not convert this ratio directly into a chip-performance multiplier.
steps.check: 計算含無因次比值及固定條件。
steps.checkEn: Provide the dimensionless ratio and held conditions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: Rayleigh 關係提供光學解析度的尺度估算。
knowledge.textEn: The Rayleigh relationship estimates resolution scaling.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: k1 代表製程與成像因素，不是永遠相同的常數。
knowledge.textEn: k1 captures imaging and process factors and need not stay constant.

quiz.question: 固定 λ 與 k1 時，提高 NA 如何影響 R？
quiz.questionEn: At fixed wavelength and k1, what does higher NA do to R?
options: 使 R 同比例變大。
使 R 變小。
完全沒有影響。
quiz.explanation: 使 R 變小。 Rayleigh 關係提供光學解析度的尺度估算。
quiz.explanationEn: It decreases R. The Rayleigh relationship estimates resolution scaling.

steps.title: 建立焦深取捨
steps.objective: 比較横向解析度與垂直容忍度。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare lateral resolution with vertical tolerance.
steps.instruction: 以 DOF 與 λ/NA² 的比例畫趨勢；比較兩種 NA；把晶圓高度誤差放入焦深帶；標記離焦風險區。
steps.instructionEn: Plot the DOF proportionality to wavelength/NA squared; compare two NAs; place wafer-height errors inside the focus band; mark defocus-risk regions.
steps.observation: 更細的成像通常伴隨更小的高度容忍度。
steps.observationEn: Finer imaging generally comes with tighter height tolerance.
steps.failure: 若只看解析度，補上焦深及表面高度誤差預算。
steps.failureEn: Add focus depth and height-error budgets to resolution-only analysis.
steps.check: 一圖同時顯示解析度收益與焦深代價。
steps.checkEn: One figure shows both resolution benefit and focus-depth cost.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 固定其他因素時，焦深對 NA 的平方敏感。
knowledge.textEn: With other factors fixed, focus depth scales inversely with NA squared.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 真實製程視窗仍受光阻、圖案及量測定義影響。
knowledge.textEn: Actual process windows also depend on resist, pattern and measurement definition.

quiz.question: 提高 NA 後哪項控制更重要？
quiz.questionEn: What control becomes more demanding as NA increases?
options: 任意放寬表面起伏。
完全取消光阻厚度檢查。
焦距與晶圓高度控制。
quiz.explanation: 焦距與晶圓高度控制。 固定其他因素時，焦深對 NA 的平方敏感。
quiz.explanationEn: Focus and wafer-height control. With other factors fixed, focus depth scales inversely with NA squared.

steps.title: 追蹤反射式 EUV 光路
steps.titleEn: Trace the reflective EUV optical path
steps.objective: 理解光源到光阻的損耗介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand loss interfaces from source to resist.
steps.instruction: 畫光源、照明鏡、光罩及投影鏡；在每次反射標能量流向；用假設反射率連乘比較損耗；說明為何使用真空。
steps.instructionEn: Draw source, illumination mirrors, mask and projection mirrors; mark energy flow at each reflection; multiply hypothetical reflectivities; explain the vacuum path.
steps.observation: 多次反射的損耗會累積。
steps.observationEn: Losses accumulate across reflections.
steps.failure: 勿以可見光玻璃透鏡取代 EUV 反射光學。
steps.failureEn: Do not substitute visible-light glass lenses for EUV reflective optics.
steps.check: 光路圖包含真空邊界及逐段損耗。
steps.checkEn: Include vacuum boundaries and segment losses.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: EUV 易被材料吸收，因此系統採用反射鏡與真空。
knowledge.textEn: EUV absorption motivates mirrors and vacuum.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 單一元件的反射率不等於整機傳輸率。
knowledge.textEn: One mirror's reflectivity is not the system transmission.

quiz.question: 多面鏡的總傳輸如何估計？
quiz.questionEn: How is transmission across mirrors estimated?
options: 在簡化模型中連乘各段傳輸率。
把百分比直接相加。
只看最後一面鏡。
optionsEn: Multiply segment transmissions in a simplified model.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化模型中連乘各段傳輸率。 EUV 易被材料吸收，因此系統採用反射鏡與真空。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiply segment transmissions in a simplified model. EUV absorption motivates mirrors and vacuum.

steps.title: 驗證非等倍率縮小
steps.objective: 把光罩座標正確轉到晶圓。
steps.objectiveEn: Map mask coordinates correctly to wafer coordinates.
steps.instruction: 畫長方形光罩圖案；在兩軸分別用 4× 與 8× 縮小；計算四角座標；反算光罩尺寸以得到指定晶圓長寬。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a rectangular mask pattern; apply 4x and 8x demagnification on separate axes; calculate all corners; invert the mapping for a target wafer rectangle.
steps.observation: 相同光罩邊長在兩方向產生不同晶圓尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Equal mask lengths produce different wafer lengths along the two axes.
steps.failure: 如果成像比例錯，先核對軸定義而非旋轉圖形掩飾。
steps.failureEn: Check axis definitions rather than rotating a wrongly scaled image.
steps.check: 正向與反向座標轉換互相一致。
steps.checkEn: Forward and inverse coordinate transforms agree.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: High-NA 光學採用兩方向不同縮小倍率。
knowledge.textEn: High-NA optics use unequal demagnification along two axes.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 非等倍率影響光罩資料、曝光場與接縫規劃。
knowledge.textEn: Anamorphic scaling affects mask data, exposure fields and stitching.

quiz.question: 同一光罩正方形必然成為晶圓正方形嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Must a square mask feature remain square on the wafer?
options: 一定，只要使用 EUV。
不一定，兩軸倍率不同。
一定，倍率不影响形狀。
quiz.explanation: 不一定，兩軸倍率不同。 High-NA 光學採用兩方向不同縮小倍率。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the axis magnifications differ. High-NA optics use unequal demagnification along two axes.

steps.title: 建立光學與製程責任界面
steps.objective: 避免把全部圖案問題歸給投影鏡。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid assigning every pattern error to projection optics.
steps.instruction: 列出光源、光罩、光阻與平台四介面；為各介面指定可觀測量；畫資料交接箭頭；給一個線寬偏差案例分配排查順序。
steps.instructionEn: List source, mask, resist and stage interfaces; assign observables; draw data handoffs; order checks for a linewidth-deviation case.
steps.observation: 同樣的線寬偏差可來自多種因素。
steps.observationEn: Similar width errors can have several causes.
steps.failure: 沒有隔離證據時，不把相關性寫成單一根因。
steps.failureEn: Without isolation evidence, do not state a single root cause.
steps.check: 介面表含輸入、輸出及責任量測。
steps.checkEn: The interface table includes inputs, outputs and assigned measurements.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 成像品質由光學、材料及機電共同形成。
knowledge.textEn: Imaging quality emerges from optics, materials and mechatronics.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 跨設備資料必須使用可對應的位置與時間標記。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-tool data need matching spatial and time identifiers.

quiz.question: 圖案偏差可以僅憑照片判定鏡面故障嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can a pattern photo alone establish mirror failure?
options: 可以，光阻不影响圖案。
可以，所有誤差都源自光源。
不能，需分離其他介面因素。
optionsEn: Yes; every error originates at the source.
No; other interface factors need isolation.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需分離其他介面因素。 成像品質由光學、材料及機電共同形成。
quiz.explanationEn: No; other interface factors need isolation. Imaging quality emerges from optics, materials and mechatronics.

stages.title: 光罩、光阻與圖案轉移
stages.description: 將光罩幾何與光阻、底層、蝕刻聯合判讀。
stages.descriptionEn: Interpret mask geometry together with resist, underlayers and etch.

steps.title: 辨認光罩三維效應
steps.objective: 區分平面設計與真實吸收層。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish layout from a physical absorber stack.
steps.instruction: 畫反射多層膜與吸收層截面；加入斜入射光；比較兩個圖案方向；標記可能造成位置或最佳焦距差異的介面。
steps.instructionEn: Draw reflector and absorber sections; add oblique incidence; compare pattern orientations; mark interfaces that may shift position or best focus.
steps.observation: 光罩不是沒有厚度的黑白投影片。
steps.observationEn: A mask is not a thickness-free black-and-white transparency.
steps.failure: 若平面模型無法說明方向差異，列入三維光學效應。
steps.failureEn: Consider 3D optics when a planar model cannot explain orientation effects.
steps.check: 說明一項平面模型遺漏的效應及驗證方法。
steps.checkEn: Explain one effect missing from a planar model and how to check it.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 吸收層與多層膜可改變相位及影像對比。
knowledge.textEn: Absorber and multilayer structures can affect phase and contrast.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 不同圖案方向可能需要分開評估。
knowledge.textEn: Different pattern orientations may need separate evaluation.

quiz.question: 為何需要光罩截面？
quiz.questionEn: Why is a mask section needed?
options: 厚度與斜入射會影響成像。
光罩沒有任何反射。
平面尺寸永遠不重要。
optionsEn: Thickness and oblique illumination affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 厚度與斜入射會影響成像。 吸收層與多層膜可改變相位及影像對比。
quiz.explanationEn: Thickness and oblique illumination affect imaging. Absorber and multilayer structures can affect phase and contrast.

steps.title: 比較光罩補償前後輪廓
steps.objective: 理解光學鄰近修正的目的。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand the purpose of optical proximity correction.
steps.instruction: 畫目標轉角與未補償成像輪廓；添加原創示意補償形狀；比較孤立線與密集線；標註仍須以模型及晶圓驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Draw target corners and uncorrected contours; add an original schematic compensation; compare isolated and dense lines; mark the need for model and wafer validation.
steps.observation: 光罩形狀不必與最終圖案完全相同。
steps.observationEn: Mask shape need not duplicate the final pattern.
steps.failure: 不要把手畫補償尺寸當成可製造光罩資料。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat hand-drawn compensation dimensions as mask-production data.
steps.check: 示意圖清楚分開目標、光罩及預測影像。
steps.checkEn: Separate target, mask and predicted image.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 補償藉由改變輸入形狀改善印出的目標輪廓。
knowledge.textEn: Compensation changes input geometry to improve printed contours.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 同一補償可能受鄰近圖案及照明條件影響。
knowledge.textEn: Compensation depends on neighboring patterns and illumination.

quiz.question: 補償成功的判據是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What determines successful compensation?
options: 光罩看起來和目標完全相同。
晶圓輪廓更接近目標且視窗可接受。
只增加所有圖案面積。
optionsEn: The mask looks identical to the target.
Wafer contours approach target within an acceptable window.
quiz.explanation: 晶圓輪廓更接近目標且視窗可接受。 補償藉由改變輸入形狀改善印出的目標輪廓。
quiz.explanationEn: Wafer contours approach target within an acceptable window. Compensation changes input geometry to improve printed contours.

steps.title: 比較光阻厚度與倒塌風險
steps.titleEn: Compare resist thickness and collapse risk
steps.objective: 用高寬比理解結構穩定。
steps.objectiveEn: Use aspect ratio to discuss feature stability.
steps.instruction: 畫同寬不同高的三條光阻線；計算高度除以寬度；比較離焦與倒塌風險；列出薄化後圖案轉移的新要求。
steps.instructionEn: Draw equal-width resist lines at three heights; calculate height/width; compare focus and collapse concerns; list transfer demands after thinning.
steps.observation: 較薄光阻可能有利成像但留下更少蝕刻餘量。
steps.observationEn: Thinner resist can help imaging while reducing etch margin.
steps.failure: 若只追求低高寬比，補上後續轉移厚度預算。
steps.failureEn: Add transfer-thickness budgeting to aspect-ratio optimization.
steps.check: 比較表含焦深、穩定與轉移三面向。
steps.checkEn: Compare focus depth, stability and transfer.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 高寬比把厚度與線寬連結到結構問題。
knowledge.textEn: Aspect ratio relates height and width to structural concerns.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 光阻最佳厚度須與底層及蝕刻共同設計。
knowledge.textEn: Resist thickness must be designed with underlayers and etch.

quiz.question: 光阻越薄是否必然越好？
quiz.questionEn: Is thinner resist always better?
options: 是，蝕刻不需要任何遮罩。
是，薄膜不可能有缺陷。
否，還要滿足圖案轉移要求。
optionsEn: Yes; thin films cannot have defects.
No; pattern transfer must still work.
quiz.explanation: 否，還要滿足圖案轉移要求。 高寬比把厚度與線寬連結到結構問題。
quiz.explanationEn: No; pattern transfer must still work. Aspect ratio relates height and width to structural concerns.

steps.title: 建立光阻與底層介面圖
steps.objective: 把黏附、形貌與轉移一起審查。
steps.objectiveEn: Review adhesion, morphology and transfer together.
steps.instruction: 畫光阻、底層與目標膜；標示各層作用；比較兩種假設底層造成的線形差異；規劃只改底層的對照組。
steps.instructionEn: Draw resist, underlayer and target film; label roles; compare hypothetical line-shape changes for two underlayers; design an underlayer-only control.
steps.observation: 相同光阻不保證在不同底層有相同結果。
steps.observationEn: The same resist need not behave identically on different underlayers.
steps.failure: 同時換光阻與底層會混淆原因，拆成實驗矩陣。
steps.failureEn: Separate simultaneous resist and underlayer changes into a matrix.
steps.check: 每層有功能、關鍵介面與觀察項。
steps.checkEn: Each layer has a function, interface and observable.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 光阻與底層需共同最佳化。
knowledge.textEn: Resist and underlayer require co-optimization.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 單一材料排名不能取代堆疊整合驗證。
knowledge.textEn: A material ranking cannot replace stack-integration verification.

quiz.question: 如何先辨認底層影響？
quiz.questionEn: How can underlayer effects first be isolated?
options: 固定光阻及其他條件比較底層。
同時更改所有堆疊。
只比較材料商品名稱。
optionsEn: Hold resist and other conditions fixed.
quiz.explanation: 固定光阻及其他條件比較底層。 光阻與底層需共同最佳化。
quiz.explanationEn: Hold resist and other conditions fixed. Resist and underlayer require co-optimization.

steps.title: 區分光子與材料隨機性
steps.objective: 理解少數缺陷與平均線寬的差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish rare defects from average linewidth.
steps.instruction: 畫相同目標的二十個接觸孔；加入自訂缺孔與尺寸擾動；分別統計平均尺寸及缺孔數；比較兩批平均相同的資料。
steps.instructionEn: Draw twenty target contacts; add hypothetical missing holes and size variations; count mean size and missing holes separately; compare batches with equal means.
steps.observation: 平均尺寸一致仍可能有不同失敗率。
steps.observationEn: Equal mean size can coexist with different failure rates.
steps.failure: 不要以二十個樣本推估量產極低缺陷率；註明樣本限制。
steps.failureEn: Do not infer production-scale rare-event rates from twenty samples.
steps.check: 同時報告平均、散布、缺陷數與樣本數。
steps.checkEn: Report mean, spread, defect count and sample size.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 隨機缺陷需用分布及事件數評估。
knowledge.textEn: Stochastic defects require distributions and event counts.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 看不到缺陷不等於缺陷機率為零。
knowledge.textEn: Observing no defects does not establish zero probability.

quiz.question: 平均線寬正常就可排除缺孔嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a normal mean linewidth rule out missing holes?
options: 可以，平均值涵蓋所有拓撲。
不能，需單獨檢查缺陷事件。
可以，只需增加影像亮度。
optionsEn: Yes; a mean captures all topology.
No; defect events need separate inspection.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需單獨檢查缺陷事件。 隨機缺陷需用分布及事件數評估。
quiz.explanationEn: No; defect events need separate inspection. Stochastic defects require distributions and event counts.

steps.title: 追蹤顯影到蝕刻的圖案變化
steps.titleEn: Track patterns from development to etch
steps.objective: 避免只用光阻圖案評估最終結構。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid assessing final structures from resist alone.
steps.instruction: 畫顯影後、硬遮罩後與目標膜後三個輪廓；逐站標線寬變化；比較斜壁與頂視影像；分配每站允許的教學誤差預算。
steps.instructionEn: Draw post-develop, hard-mask and target-film contours; mark width changes; compare sloped walls with top views; allocate hypothetical error budgets by stage.
steps.observation: 頂視線寬相同可對應不同側壁。
steps.observationEn: Equal top-view widths can hide different sidewalls.
steps.failure: 未取得蝕刻後證據時，結論只限光阻階段。
steps.failureEn: Without after-etch evidence, limit conclusions to the resist stage.
steps.check: 三站輪廓與每次轉移偏差可對應。
steps.checkEn: Match three contours and transfer deviations.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 最終圖案是曝光、顯影與轉移共同結果。
knowledge.textEn: The final pattern combines exposure, development and transfer.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 每次轉移可能改變尺寸與形貌。
knowledge.textEn: Each transfer can change dimensions and morphology.

quiz.question: 光阻照片能否保證目標膜形貌？
quiz.questionEn: Can a resist photo guarantee target-film geometry?
options: 能，所有層必定等比例複製。
能，只要曝光一次。
不能，需蝕刻後量測。
quiz.explanation: 不能，需蝕刻後量測。 最終圖案是曝光、顯影與轉移共同結果。
quiz.explanationEn: No; after-etch metrology is needed. The final pattern combines exposure, development and transfer.

stages.title: 平台、焦距與曝光場
stages.description: 建立定位、場接縫與時間預算。
stages.descriptionEn: Build positioning, stitching and timing budgets.

steps.title: 推演晶圓與光罩同步掃描
steps.titleEn: Model synchronized wafer and mask scanning
steps.objective: 建立兩平台相對運動的概念。
steps.objectiveEn: Model relative motion of both stages.
steps.instruction: 畫曝光狹縫與兩平台；指定示意縮小倍率；推演對應位移；加入一段速度誤差並標記其影像方向。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an exposure slit and both stages; choose a schematic demagnification; derive corresponding displacements; add a velocity error and mark its image direction.
steps.observation: 平台各自位置正確仍須保持相對同步。
steps.observationEn: Individually correct positions still require relative synchronization.
steps.failure: 若兩平台使用相同位移卻倍率不同，重算對應關係。
steps.failureEn: Recalculate mapping if both stages move equally despite demagnification.
steps.check: 時間圖顯示兩平台與相對誤差。
steps.checkEn: A time plot shows both stages and relative error.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 掃描成像需要平台運動與光學倍率一致。
knowledge.textEn: Scanning requires motion consistent with optical scaling.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 同步誤差需按曝光時刻評估。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronization error must be evaluated during exposure.

quiz.question: 只檢查平台終點位置足夠嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Is checking only final stage position enough?
options: 不夠，曝光期間同步也重要。
足夠，中途軌跡不影響影像。
足夠，兩平台不需配合。
optionsEn: Yes; the intermediate path cannot affect imaging.
quiz.explanation: 不夠，曝光期間同步也重要。 掃描成像需要平台運動與光學倍率一致。
quiz.explanationEn: No; synchronization during exposure matters. Scanning requires motion consistent with optical scaling.

steps.title: 規劃半曝光場拼接
steps.objective: 辨認接縫處的對準與連接問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify alignment and continuity at field seams.
steps.instruction: 把示意晶片切成兩個場；畫一條跨接縫導線；分別加入平移與縮放偏差；比較開路、短路及重疊情境。
steps.instructionEn: Split a schematic die into two fields; draw a crossing line; add translation and scaling errors separately; compare open, short and overlap cases.
steps.observation: 接縫不是把兩張圖靠近就完成。
steps.observationEn: Stitching is more than placing images side by side.
steps.failure: 不要假設每個晶片都需拼接；先比較晶片與曝光場大小。
steps.failureEn: Compare die and field sizes before assuming stitching is required.
steps.check: 說明何時需要拼接及如何檢查邊界。
steps.checkEn: Explain when stitching is needed and how boundaries are checked.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 非等倍率使曝光場規劃改變。
knowledge.textEn: Anamorphic optics change exposure-field planning.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 跨場圖案需額外檢查位置與連續性。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-field patterns need alignment and continuity checks.

quiz.question: 所有晶片一定需兩場拼接嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Must every die use two stitched fields?
options: 一定，與晶片大小無關。
不一定，取決於晶片與場的尺寸。
不必，接縫永遠沒有誤差。
optionsEn: No; it depends on die and field size.
No, because seams can never have errors.
quiz.explanation: 不一定，取決於晶片與場的尺寸。 非等倍率使曝光場規劃改變。
quiz.explanationEn: No; it depends on die and field size. Anamorphic optics change exposure-field planning.

steps.title: 建立晶圓高度與焦距圖
steps.titleEn: Build a wafer-height and focus map
steps.objective: 把形貌轉為可校正的誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Translate topography into correctable errors.
steps.instruction: 畫九點高度圖；扣除整體傾斜平面；將殘差與假設焦深範圍比較；標記需重測或限制曝光的位置。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a nine-point height map; subtract a best-fit tilt plane; compare residuals with a hypothetical focus range; flag sites for remeasurement or exposure limits.
steps.observation: 平面傾斜校正後仍可能有局部起伏。
steps.observationEn: Local topography can remain after tilt correction.
steps.failure: 若只用中心點對焦，增加邊緣與局部高點取樣。
steps.failureEn: Add edge and local-high sampling to center-only focusing.
steps.check: 原始高度、校正量與殘差均有紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Record raw heights, corrections and residuals.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 焦距控制依賴可追溯的高度量測。
knowledge.textEn: Focus control depends on traceable height measurements.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 校正模型的自由度有限，不能消除所有形貌。
knowledge.textEn: A correction model has finite freedom and cannot erase all topography.

quiz.question: 扣除傾斜後還應看什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What remains to inspect after removing tilt?
options: 只看全片平均高度。
刪除不符合平面的數據。
局部殘差是否超出焦距容忍。
optionsEn: Delete data not fitting the plane.
Whether local residuals exceed focus tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 局部殘差是否超出焦距容忍。 焦距控制依賴可追溯的高度量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether local residuals exceed focus tolerance. Focus control depends on traceable height measurements.

steps.title: 比較熱漂移與隨機振動
steps.titleEn: Compare thermal drift and random vibration
steps.objective: 按時間尺度分類位置誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Classify positioning error by time scale.
steps.instruction: 畫緩慢漂移及快速擾動兩條假設訊號；選不同取樣間隔；比較可觀測成分；為兩類問題分別指定溫度或位置證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw slow drift and fast disturbance signals; choose sampling intervals; compare observable components; assign temperature or position evidence to each.
steps.observation: 相同誤差幅度不一定需要相同校正。
steps.observationEn: Equal error amplitudes can require different corrections.
steps.failure: 過慢取樣可能漏掉快速擾動；保留量測頻寬。
steps.failureEn: Slow sampling can miss fast disturbances; retain bandwidth information.
steps.check: 分類含時間尺度、感測量與修正假說。
steps.checkEn: Classify time scale, sensing quantity and correction hypothesis.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 機電精度同時受環境與運動狀態影響。
knowledge.textEn: Mechatronic precision depends on environment and motion.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 量測頻率必須適合欲觀察的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling must suit the changes being observed.

quiz.question: 慢速溫度紀錄能否排除快速振動？
quiz.questionEn: Can slow temperature logging exclude fast vibration?
options: 不能，需適當頻寬的位置量測。
能，所有誤差都有同一頻率。
能，只要平均溫度固定。
optionsEn: No; position measurement with suitable bandwidth is needed.
Yes; all errors share one frequency.
Yes, if average temperature is fixed.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需適當頻寬的位置量測。 機電精度同時受環境與運動狀態影響。
quiz.explanationEn: No; position measurement with suitable bandwidth is needed. Mechatronic precision depends on environment and motion.

steps.title: 拆解曝光時間與產能
steps.objective: 避免以曝光次數直接判定總產能。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid deriving total throughput from exposure count alone.
steps.instruction: 列出對準、移動、曝光與換片時間；建立兩種假設排程；分別增加場數及縮短平台時間；比較總時間及瓶頸。
steps.instructionEn: List alignment, motion, exposure and exchange times; create two hypothetical schedules; vary field count and stage time separately; compare totals and bottlenecks.
steps.observation: 場數增加不等於總時間必然成同比例增加。
steps.observationEn: More fields do not force total time to increase proportionally.
steps.failure: 不要用公開峰值代替實際光阻劑量與排程條件。
steps.failureEn: Do not substitute peak claims for dose and scheduling conditions.
steps.check: 以同條件時間帳本比較方案。
steps.checkEn: Compare schemes using a timing ledger under matching conditions.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 產能由多個時間項及重疊作業共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput depends on several time terms and overlap.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 劑量、場數與平台速度的取捨需共同審查。
knowledge.textEn: Dose, field count and stage speed require joint review.

quiz.question: 半場是否必然使每片時間加倍？
quiz.questionEn: Does a half field necessarily double wafer time?
options: 必然，其他動作時間為零。
不必然，要看完整時間預算。
完全不影响任何時間項。
optionsEn: Yes; all other actions take zero time.
Not necessarily; inspect the full timing budget.
It cannot affect any time term.
quiz.explanation: 不必然，要看完整時間預算。 產能由多個時間項及重疊作業共同決定。
quiz.explanationEn: Not necessarily; inspect the full timing budget. Throughput depends on several time terms and overlap.

steps.title: 追蹤曝光場內的劑量分布
steps.titleEn: Track dose distribution within a field
steps.objective: 區分平均能量與局部曝光均勻性。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate average energy from local exposure uniformity.
steps.instruction: 畫中心與兩側三區曝光圖；指定相同平均但不同分布的假設劑量；比較每區線寬回應；列出感測器位置及校正證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw center and two edge exposure zones; assign equal-average but differently distributed hypothetical doses; compare local linewidth responses; list sensor positions and calibration evidence.
steps.observation: 平均曝光量相同仍可能有場內差異。
steps.observationEn: Equal average exposure can conceal within-field differences.
steps.failure: 若只看總能量，補上位置分布，避免把光阻差異全部歸因於光源。
steps.failureEn: Add spatial distribution to total energy and avoid attributing every resist difference to the source.
steps.check: 交出每區劑量、觀察及可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Report dose, observation and potential confounders by zone.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 曝光品質包含空間與時間的均勻性。
knowledge.textEn: Exposure quality includes spatial and temporal uniformity.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 量測點的覆蓋範圍會限制對全場的結論。
knowledge.textEn: Measurement coverage limits conclusions about the whole field.

quiz.question: 平均劑量相同是否證明全場曝光一致？
quiz.questionEn: Does equal average dose prove uniform field exposure?
options: 是，平均值等於每個點。
是，場邊永遠沒有誤差。
否，還需檢查空間分布。
optionsEn: Yes; the average equals every point.
Yes; field edges never have errors.
quiz.explanation: 否，還需檢查空間分布。 曝光品質包含空間與時間的均勻性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; inspect spatial distribution. Exposure quality includes spatial and temporal uniformity.

stages.title: 量測、缺陷與整合驗證
stages.description: 把影像、製程視窗與電性測試連接成證據鏈。
stages.descriptionEn: Connect images, process windows and electrical tests into an evidence chain.

steps.title: 建立焦距與劑量矩陣
steps.objective: 以多條件找可接受製程區域。
steps.objectiveEn: Find acceptable regions across conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫三個焦距×三個相對劑量的假設矩陣；填入示意線寬及缺陷觀察；圈出同時符合兩條件的區域；標明數值不供設備設定。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a hypothetical three-focus by three-relative-dose matrix; enter illustrative widths and defects; outline the region meeting both conditions; label values as non-operational.
steps.observation: 單一最佳點不代表有寬廣製程視窗。
steps.observationEn: One optimum point does not establish a broad process window.
steps.failure: 若只選線寬最接近的一格，加入缺陷與鄰近格穩定性。
steps.failureEn: Add defects and neighboring-condition stability to closest-width selection.
steps.check: 判定使用至少兩項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Use at least two quality criteria.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 製程視窗是同時滿足條件的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A process window is a range satisfying joint conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 裕量比單次最佳結果更有助於穩定性判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Margin is more informative about robustness than one optimum result.

quiz.question: 只有一格合格代表什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does only one passing matrix cell indicate?
options: 可能視窗狹窄，需更多驗證。
已證明任何條件都穩定。
可刪除所有失敗格。
optionsEn: A potentially narrow window needing more checks.
Stability under every condition is proven.
All failing cells may be removed.
quiz.explanation: 可能視窗狹窄，需更多驗證。 製程視窗是同時滿足條件的範圍。
quiz.explanationEn: A potentially narrow window needing more checks. A process window is a range satisfying joint conditions.

steps.title: 分辨 CD、疊對與邊緣位置
steps.titleEn: Separate CD, overlay and edge placement
steps.objective: 避免不同誤差指標互相替代。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid substituting one error metric for another.
steps.instruction: 畫上下兩層線路；分別改變寬度與平移；量出 CD、層間偏移與目標邊緣差；比較兩項誤差相加的情況。
steps.instructionEn: Draw lines on two layers; vary width and translation separately; measure CD, layer offset and target-edge difference; compare combined errors.
steps.observation: CD 合格仍可能因疊對偏差造成連接失敗。
steps.observationEn: Passing CD can coexist with failed connections from overlay error.
steps.failure: 若只報單一「精度」，指定其物理定義與位置。
steps.failureEn: Replace a generic accuracy number with a physical definition and location.
steps.check: 三種指標各有圖示與量測基準。
steps.checkEn: Illustrate all three metrics with measurement references.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 尺寸與位置是不同的品質維度。
knowledge.textEn: Size and position are distinct quality dimensions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 邊緣位置可能同時受尺寸與疊對影響。
knowledge.textEn: Edge position can reflect both size and overlay.

quiz.question: CD 合格能否證明層間對準？
quiz.questionEn: Does passing CD prove interlayer alignment?
options: 能，寬度就是位置。
不能，疊對需另測。
能，只要線條發亮。
quiz.explanation: 不能，疊對需另測。 尺寸與位置是不同的品質維度。
quiz.explanationEn: No; overlay requires separate measurement. Size and position are distinct quality dimensions.

steps.title: 規劃光學與電子束互補檢查
steps.titleEn: Plan complementary optical and e-beam checks
steps.objective: 匹配檢查速度與缺陷解析度。
steps.objectiveEn: Match inspection speed and defect resolution.
steps.instruction: 列出全片趨勢與局部缺陷兩類問題；為各類選量測工具；設計熱點加隨機位置取樣；比較只查熱點會漏掉的情況。
steps.instructionEn: Separate whole-wafer trends from local defects; assign tools; sample hotspots plus random sites; compare what hotspot-only inspection could miss.
steps.observation: 快速取樣與高解析檢查需互相補充。
steps.observationEn: Fast sampling and high-resolution inspection complement each other.
steps.failure: 不宣稱取樣等於全片每一結構檢查。
steps.failureEn: Do not equate sampling with inspection of every structure.
steps.check: 計畫列出覆蓋範圍、解析能力與未覆蓋區。
steps.checkEn: State coverage, resolving capability and gaps.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 光學量測與電子束檢查具有不同速度與資訊特性。
knowledge.textEn: Optical metrology and e-beam inspection differ in speed and information.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 取樣策略會影響可發現的缺陷種類。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling strategy changes the defects likely to be found.

quiz.question: 只檢查已知熱點有何限制？
quiz.questionEn: What limits hotspot-only inspection?
options: 能保證沒有任何缺陷。
使儀器解析度無限大。
可能漏掉未知位置的缺陷。
optionsEn: It may miss defects in unexpected locations.
quiz.explanation: 可能漏掉未知位置的缺陷。 光學量測與電子束檢查具有不同速度與資訊特性。
quiz.explanationEn: It may miss defects in unexpected locations. Optical metrology and e-beam inspection differ in speed and information.

steps.title: 建立缺陷分類與電性對照
steps.objective: 把影像異常轉成可驗證的功能假說。
steps.objectiveEn: Translate image anomalies into testable functional hypotheses.
steps.instruction: 畫橋接、缺孔及線頸三種原創示意；預測短路、開路或高阻；配對假設電性結果；列出影像不足以判斷的案例。
steps.instructionEn: Draw original bridge, missing-contact and necking examples; predict short, open or high resistance; pair hypothetical electrical results; list cases images cannot resolve.
steps.observation: 可見形貌與電性失敗需建立對照。
steps.observationEn: Visible morphology and electrical failure need correlation.
steps.failure: 不要將每個影像雜點都標成失效；先查成像與樣品條件。
steps.failureEn: Check imaging and sample conditions before treating every speck as a defect.
steps.check: 分類表包含形貌、功能假說與追加證據。
steps.checkEn: Include morphology, functional hypothesis and additional evidence.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 缺陷的功能影響取決於位置及連接關係。
knowledge.textEn: Functional impact depends on location and connectivity.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 影像分類須與其他證據交叉確認。
knowledge.textEn: Image classification needs cross-checks.

quiz.question: 一個雜點能直接證明短路嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a speck directly prove a short?
options: 不能，需確認形貌與電性。
能，任何雜點都導電。
能，影像不可能有雜訊。
optionsEn: No; morphology and electrical evidence are needed.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需確認形貌與電性。 缺陷的功能影響取決於位置及連接關係。
quiz.explanationEn: No; morphology and electrical evidence are needed. Functional impact depends on location and connectivity.

steps.title: 比較 DUV、多重圖案化與 High NA
steps.titleEn: Compare DUV, multipatterning and High NA
steps.objective: 依圖層需求選擇方法而非技術排名。
steps.objectiveEn: Select methods by layer requirements rather than prestige.
steps.instruction: 為三種示意圖層列出節距、場大小及產能需求；比較單次與多次圖案化的步驟；標出疊對及成本項；說明一個不需 High NA 的案例。
steps.instructionEn: Specify pitch, field size and throughput for three illustrative layers; compare single and multiple patterning; mark overlay and cost terms; explain a layer not requiring High NA.
steps.observation: 不同圖層可使用不同微影策略。
steps.observationEn: Different layers can use different lithography strategies.
steps.failure: 不能把所有舊設備視為失效；先看需求匹配。
steps.failureEn: Match requirements before treating older tools as unsuitable.
steps.check: 選擇表有需求、收益、限制與衍生課程。
steps.checkEn: The selection table includes needs, benefits, limits and related study.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 製程選擇需整合解析度、成本與圖案轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Process selection integrates resolution, cost and transfer.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 更高 NA 不自動成為每層的最佳選項。
knowledge.textEn: Higher NA is not automatically best for every layer.

quiz.question: 哪種比較最合理？
quiz.questionEn: Which comparison is most useful?
options: 單純依設備新舊排名。
在同一圖層需求下比較完整流程。
只看最小公開線寬。
optionsEn: Compare complete flows for the same layer requirements.
quiz.explanation: 在同一圖層需求下比較完整流程。 製程選擇需整合解析度、成本與圖案轉移。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare complete flows for the same layer requirements. Process selection integrates resolution, cost and transfer.

steps.title: 完成成像整合交付
steps.objective: 用完整證據支持下一輪試驗。
steps.objectiveEn: Support the next experiment with complete evidence.
steps.instruction: 收集尺度表、焦距矩陣與缺陷分類；標記每張圖是自繪、假設或實測來源；列出三個未解問題；提出優先驗證的介面。
steps.instructionEn: Collect scale definitions, focus matrix and defect classification; label original, hypothetical and sourced evidence; list three unresolved questions; prioritize an interface for verification.
steps.observation: 漂亮影像不能取代統計與流程相容證據。
steps.observationEn: Attractive images cannot replace statistics and integration evidence.
steps.failure: 缺乏電性或轉移結果時，限制結論到已驗證階段。
steps.failureEn: Limit conclusions to verified stages when electrical or transfer evidence is absent.
steps.check: 交付包含可重現假設、資料對應與下一步。
steps.checkEn: Deliver reproducible assumptions, data mapping and a next step.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 整合成熟度需要多種證據互相支持。
knowledge.textEn: Integration maturity requires mutually supporting evidence.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 本課程是成像原理審查，不是光刻機建造藍圖。
knowledge.textEn: This course reviews imaging principles, not lithography-machine construction blueprints.

quiz.question: 哪項最能支持總工程師決策？
quiz.questionEn: What best supports a chief engineer's decision?
options: 只展示單張最佳照片。
宣稱公開原理等於完整量產配方。
可追溯的視窗、缺陷與未知項。
optionsEn: Claim public principles are a complete production recipe.
quiz.explanation: 可追溯的視窗、缺陷與未知項。 整合成熟度需要多種證據互相支持。
quiz.explanationEn: Traceable windows, defects and unknowns. Integration maturity requires mutually supporting evidence.

courses.title: 高壓直流換流站
courses.summary: 從兩端電網需求、LCC/VSC 選擇、變壓器與閥廳，到冷卻、控制、故障回放及工廠驗收規劃，完成換流站概念設計。
courses.summaryEn: Develop a converter-station concept from grid needs, LCC/VSC choices, transformers and valves through cooling, control, fault replay and factory-test planning.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的四階段、24 個教學工作包；每步需交出模型、判讀或驗證紀錄。數值練習為自訂教學案例，不是廠商製程配方、現場操作許可或專業設計認證。
courses.scopeEn: Four stages and 24 educational work packages based on public principles. Each step produces a model, interpretation or verification record. Numerical exercises are hypothetical, not manufacturer recipes, field operating authorization or professional design certification.

stages.title: 電網需求與架構
stages.description: 界定功率、電壓、電網與拓撲的設計邊界。
stages.descriptionEn: Define power, voltage, grid and topology boundaries.

steps.title: 界定兩端電網與服務需求
steps.titleEn: Define both grids and the required service
steps.objective: 分開輸送功率與電網支持目標。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate transmitted power from grid-support goals.
steps.instruction: 畫兩端交流電網及中間直流鏈路；列出能量輸送與電壓支持需求；標記正常與備援情境；把未知短路強度列成待取得資料。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both AC grids and the DC link; list power-transfer and voltage-support needs; mark normal and contingency cases; flag unknown grid strength.
steps.observation: 額定功率一項不足以描述站的工作。
steps.observationEn: A power rating alone does not describe station duties.
steps.failure: 若需求只剩 MW 數字，加入方向、可用率及電網條件。
steps.failureEn: Add direction, availability and grid conditions to a MW-only requirement.
steps.check: 需求表清楚標示已知、假設與待確認項。
steps.checkEn: Requirements distinguish known, assumed and unresolved items.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: HVDC 是兩端電網之間的可控能量介面。
knowledge.textEn: HVDC forms a controllable energy interface between grids.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 兩端條件可能不同，應分別建模。
knowledge.textEn: Terminal conditions can differ and need separate models.

quiz.question: 設計換流站首先需要什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What comes first in converter-station design?
options: 兩端電網及服務需求。
只決定閥廳外觀。
先指定任意保護門檻。
optionsEn: Both grid conditions and service requirements.
quiz.explanation: 兩端電網及服務需求。 HVDC 是兩端電網之間的可控能量介面。
quiz.explanationEn: Both grid conditions and service requirements. HVDC forms a controllable energy interface between grids.

steps.title: 建立 AC 到 DC 的能量帳本
steps.objective: 分辨輸入、輸出與損耗。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish input, output and losses.
steps.instruction: 為兩站及線路畫功率箭頭；用自訂低精度假設值計算損耗；檢查送端與受端能量平衡；另列站用電。
steps.instructionEn: Draw power arrows for both stations and the line; calculate losses with clearly hypothetical values; balance sending and receiving power; list auxiliary demand separately.
steps.observation: 站內損耗與線路損耗是不同項。
steps.observationEn: Station and line losses are separate terms.
steps.failure: 若輸出大於輸入又無儲能釋放，查單位與符號。
steps.failureEn: Check units and signs if output exceeds input without stored-energy release.
steps.check: 帳本閉合且沒有把站用電重複計算。
steps.checkEn: The ledger balances without double-counted auxiliaries.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 能量平衡可先揭露系統模型不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Energy balance can expose an inconsistent system model.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 效率比較需使用相同功率與邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Efficiency comparisons need matching power levels and boundaries.

quiz.question: 比較效率時為何先定邊界？
quiz.questionEn: Why define boundaries before comparing efficiency?
options: 因為效率與輸入無關。
避免一方漏算換流或站用損耗。
為了把所有損耗設為零。
optionsEn: To avoid omitting conversion or auxiliary losses.
To set every loss to zero.
quiz.explanation: 避免一方漏算換流或站用損耗。 能量平衡可先揭露系統模型不一致。
quiz.explanationEn: To avoid omitting conversion or auxiliary losses. Energy balance can expose an inconsistent system model.

steps.title: 比較 LCC 與 VSC 的電網依存
steps.titleEn: Compare LCC and VSC grid dependence
steps.objective: 依外部電網選擇轉換原理。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate conversion principles to grid conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫 LCC 與 VSC 功能方塊；列出換相方式；比較強網、弱網及離岸情境；標記需專案驗證的控制能力。
steps.instructionEn: Draw LCC and VSC blocks; identify commutation methods; compare strong-grid, weak-grid and offshore cases; flag project-specific control capabilities.
steps.observation: 兩類技術不是只差設備尺寸。
steps.observationEn: The technologies differ by more than equipment size.
steps.failure: 不把某產品功能外推為所有 VSC 都具備。
steps.failureEn: Do not generalize one product's features to every VSC.
steps.check: 比較表包含換相、無功與電網依存。
steps.checkEn: Compare commutation, reactive power and grid dependence.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: LCC 與 VSC 使用不同換流原理。
knowledge.textEn: LCC and VSC use different commutation principles.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 適用性取決於電網、容量與控制設計。
knowledge.textEn: Suitability depends on the grid, rating and control design.

quiz.question: 弱網情境可只比較額定 MW 嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Can a weak-grid study compare only rated MW?
options: 可以，所有電網都相同。
可以，頻率與電壓無關。
不能，還需換相與控制條件。
optionsEn: Yes; frequency and voltage are irrelevant.
No; commutation and control conditions matter.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需換相與控制條件。 LCC 與 VSC 使用不同換流原理。
quiz.explanationEn: No; commutation and control conditions matter. LCC and VSC use different commutation principles.

steps.title: 畫出單極與雙極回路
steps.objective: 辨認導體、回流及故障後能力。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify conductors, return paths and contingency capability.
steps.instruction: 畫對稱單極及雙極概念圖；標正負極與中性/回流安排；模擬一個極不可用；列出能否繼續輸送需確認的設計條件。
steps.instructionEn: Draw symmetric-monopole and bipole concepts; mark polarities and neutral/return arrangements; model one unavailable pole; list conditions governing continued transfer.
steps.observation: 兩根直流導體不一定代表同一系統配置。
steps.observationEn: Two DC conductors do not always mean the same configuration.
steps.failure: 未確認回流設計前，不宣稱任一極故障仍滿功率。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim full power after a pole failure without verifying the return design.
steps.check: 每種圖有完整回路及備援限制。
steps.checkEn: Each diagram has a complete loop and contingency limits.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 拓撲決定故障隔離與剩餘能力。
knowledge.textEn: Topology shapes fault isolation and remaining capability.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 地回路、金屬回路與導體絕緣需依專案區分。
knowledge.textEn: Earth return, metallic return and insulation are project-specific.

quiz.question: 雙極系統一極失效後能力是否固定？
quiz.questionEn: Is post-pole-failure capability universal?
options: 否，取決於回流與設備額定。
是，永遠維持全部功率。
是，永遠不能傳任何功率。
optionsEn: No; it depends on return arrangements and ratings.
Yes; full power is always retained.
Yes; no power can ever flow.
quiz.explanation: 否，取決於回流與設備額定。 拓撲決定故障隔離與剩餘能力。
quiz.explanationEn: No; it depends on return arrangements and ratings. Topology shapes fault isolation and remaining capability.

steps.title: 比較交流與直流連線的成本邊界
steps.titleEn: Compare AC and DC cost boundaries
steps.objective: 避免以單一損耗率決定方案。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid choosing a scheme from one loss percentage.
steps.instruction: 列出站、線路、維護與損耗四項成本；用假設距離畫兩種總成本曲線；改變海纜與架空條件；說明交點為何移動。
steps.instructionEn: List station, line, maintenance and loss costs; draw hypothetical total-cost curves against distance; vary cable and overhead cases; explain moving break-even points.
steps.observation: 換流站固定成本與長距離收益需一起看。
steps.observationEn: Converter fixed cost and distance-dependent benefits belong together.
steps.failure: 不把某案例損益兩平距離當通用常數。
steps.failureEn: Do not treat one example's break-even distance as universal.
steps.check: 圖表清楚寫出成本假設及敏感因子。
steps.checkEn: State cost assumptions and sensitivity factors.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 經濟比較包含建設與生命週期成本。
knowledge.textEn: Economic comparison includes construction and lifecycle costs.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 走廊、地形與許可條件會改變方案。
knowledge.textEn: Corridors, terrain and permitting conditions change choices.

quiz.question: 為何不能只用公里數判斷 HVDC？
quiz.questionEn: Why is distance alone insufficient for choosing HVDC?
options: 因為損耗永遠是零。
線路型態與換流站成本也會改變結果。
因為所有站的成本相同。
optionsEn: Line type and converter cost also change results.
Because every station costs the same.
quiz.explanation: 線路型態與換流站成本也會改變結果。 經濟比較包含建設與生命週期成本。
quiz.explanationEn: Line type and converter cost also change results. Economic comparison includes construction and lifecycle costs.

steps.title: 建立一次設備的介面清單
steps.objective: 將站內設備按功能與訊號相連。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect equipment by function and signal.
steps.instruction: 排列交流場、變壓器、閥廳、直流場；畫電力、冷卻與控制三色連線；為每個介面列責任人角色；找出一個共用失效點。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange AC yard, transformer, valve hall and DC yard; draw power, cooling and control links; assign responsible roles to interfaces; find a shared failure point.
steps.observation: 電氣完整不代表輔助系統已完整。
steps.observationEn: Electrical completeness does not establish auxiliary completeness.
steps.failure: 漏畫站用電或冷卻時，先補介面再談可用率。
steps.failureEn: Add auxiliary power and cooling before assessing availability.
steps.check: 清單覆蓋電力、資訊與熱三種交接。
steps.checkEn: Cover power, information and heat interfaces.

knowledge.title: 原理與限制
knowledge.text: 換流站是多子系統共同運作的工程。
knowledge.textEn: A converter station operates through interacting subsystems.

knowledge.title: 驗證與判讀
knowledge.text: 共用設備可形成多條路徑的共同失效。
knowledge.textEn: Shared equipment can create common-cause failures.

quiz.question: 只完成主電路能證明可運轉嗎？
quiz.questionEn: Does a complete main circuit establish operability?
options: 能，冷卻不影響轉換。
能，測量只供美觀。
不能，輔助與控制介面也必要。
optionsEn: No; auxiliary and control interfaces are also needed.
quiz.explanation: 不能，輔助與控制介面也必要。 換流站是多子系統共同運作的工程。
quiz.explanationEn: No; auxiliary and control interfaces are also needed. A converter station operates through interacting subsystems.

stages.title: 一次設備與能量路徑
stages.description: 以變壓器、閥、電抗器及冷卻介面拆解設備。
stages.descriptionEn: Decompose transformer, valve, reactor and cooling interfaces.

steps.title: 審查換流變壓器的功能
steps.objective: 區分變壓、隔離與換流負載。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate transformation, isolation and converter loading.
steps.instruction: 畫交流網與閥側兩端；標變比及絕緣邊界；比較正弦與含諧波電流的假設波形；列出需由設備規範提供的損耗與溫升證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw grid and valve sides; mark ratio and insulation boundaries; compare sinusoidal and harmonic-rich currents; list loss and temperature evidence required from specifications.
steps.observation: 額定容量相同不表示負載與絕緣應力相同。
